🌺 2026 वंजुली महाद्वादशी (दामोदर द्वादशी) माहात्म्य

जब श्रावण मास के शुक्ल पक्ष में एकादशी तिथि क्षय हो या सूर्योदय के पश्चात प्रारंभ होकर द्वादशी तिथि का विशेष संयोग बने, तब वंजुली महाद्वादशी (Vanjuli Mahadwadashi Yoga) का अत्यंत दुर्लभ और पुण्यप्रद योग बनता है। इसे दामोदर द्वादशी भी कहा जाता है।

महाद्वादशी का उपवास करने से सहस्र एकादशी व्रतों का पुण्यफल एक ही दिन में प्राप्त हो जाता है। इस दिन भगवान दामोदर (श्रीहरि विष्णु) की गरुड़ पर आरूढ़ दिव्य रूप में विशेष पूजा की जाती है।

ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय नमः ।
दामोदरं परं देवं गरुडध्वजमुत्तमम् ।
वंजुलीव्रतसम्पन्नं वन्दे संसारतारकम् ॥

📖 दामोदर द्वादशी व्रत कथा: राजा नृग की चौदह सहस्र बहेलियों से रक्षा

महर्षि दुर्वासा ने सत्यतपा ऋषि को यह पावन इतिहास सुनाया था कि सत्ययुग में राजा नृग बड़े पराक्रमी और धर्मात्मा थे। एक बार आखेट (शिकार) करते समय वे घने और भयानक जंगल में बहुत दूर निकल गए और सेना से बिछड़कर अकेले एक वटवृक्ष की छाया में विश्राम करने लगे।

रात्रि होते ही उस वन में चौदह सहस्र (14,000) क्रूर बहेलियों का दल आ धमका। उनके अग्रज वधिक ने राजा को सुवर्ण और मणियों से जड़े आभूषणों सहित सोए देखा। स्वर्ण के लोभ में उन दुष्ट बहेलियों ने राजा नृग पर एक साथ तीरों और भालों से घातक आक्रमण करने का निश्चय किया।

जैसे ही वे प्रहार करने बढ़े, ठीक उसी क्षण राजा नृग के शरीर से दिव्य चंदन, पुष्पमालाओं और तेजोमय आयुधों से सुसज्जित द्वादशी देवी प्रकट हुईं। देवी ने अपने तीक्ष्ण अस्त्रों और भीषण सिंहनाद से पलक झपकते ही समस्त 14,000 दुराचारी बहेलियों का संहार कर दिया।

जब राजा नृग की निद्रा खुली, तो सामने मारे गए बहेलियों के शव पड़े थे और वह अलौकिक देवी पुनः उनके शरीर में समाविष्ट हो रही थीं। आश्चर्यचकित राजा ने महर्षि वामदेव के आश्रम जाकर इसका रहस्य पूछा।

महर्षि वामदेव ने बताया— "हे राजन! पूर्वजन्म में तुमने श्रद्धापूर्वक द्वादशी का उपवास किया था। वही तुम्हारी पूजित 'द्वादशी देवी' आज तुम्हारी देह से प्रकट होकर तुम्हारी रक्षा करने आई थीं।" इसके पश्चात राजा नृग ने राजधानी लौटकर जीवनपर्यंत विधिपूर्वक दामोदर द्वादशी का व्रत किया और अंत में परमपद को प्राप्त हुए।

॥ इति श्री दामोदर द्वादशी व्रत कथा सम्पूर्णम् ॥

🌺 2026 वैष्णव श्रावण पुत्रदा (पवित्रोपन्ना) एकादशी

🌺 2026 अजा (आनंदा) एकादशी माहात्म्य

भाद्रपद मास के कृष्ण पक्ष की एकादशी को अजा एकादशी (Aja Ekadashi) कहा जाता है। इसे आनंदा एकादशी भी कहते हैं।

भगवान श्रीकृष्ण ने अर्जुन को बताया था कि अजा एकादशी का उपवास समस्त पूर्व संचित पापों का विनाश कर व्यक्ति को मोक्ष प्रदान करता है। अश्वमेध यज्ञ करने से जो फल मिलता है, वही फल अजा एकादशी के विधिवत व्रत से प्राप्त हो जाता है।

ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय नमः ।
अजा सर्वपापहन्त्री सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायिनी ।
भाद्रकृष्णे तु सम्प्राप्ता मुक्तिदा भव मे विभो ॥

📖 अजा एकादशी व्रत कथा: सत्यवादी राजा हरिश्चंद्र और महर्षि गौतम

प्राचीन काल में अयोध्या नगरी में चक्रवर्ती राजा हरिश्चंद्र राज्य करते थे। वे अपनी सत्यवादिता और धर्मनिष्ठा के लिए त्रैलोक्य में प्रसिद्ध थे। दैवयोग से अपने वचनों की रक्षा के लिए उन्होंने अपना संपूर्ण राज्य, धन-वैभव, अपनी पत्नी तारावती और पुत्र रोहिताश्व तक को बेच दिया तथा स्वयं एक चांडाल के सेवक बन गए और श्मशान में शवदाह कर वसूलने लगे।

अत्यंत विपत्ति और कष्ट सहते हुए भी राजा हरिश्चंद्र ने सत्य का मार्ग कभी नहीं छोड़ा। एक दिन वे अत्यंत शोकाकुल होकर विचार कर रहे थे कि इस दारुण विपत्ति से कैसे उद्धार हो। ठीक उसी समय महर्षि गौतम वहां पधारे। राजा ने साष्टांग प्रणाम कर अपने उद्धार का उपाय पूछा।

महर्षि गौतम ने दयार्द्र होकर कहा— "हे राजन! आज से सात दिन पश्चात भाद्रपद कृष्ण पक्ष की अजा एकादशी आएगी। तुम श्रद्धापूर्वक उपवास करो और रात्रि जागरण कर श्री हरि का ध्यान करो। इसके पुण्य से तुम्हारे पूर्वजन्म के समस्त पाप नष्ट हो जाएंगे।"

राजा हरिश्चंद्र ने महर्षि के वचनानुसार अजा एकादशी का विधिपूर्वक व्रत किया और रात्रि जागरण किया। व्रत के प्रभाव से उनके पूर्वजन्म के समस्त पाप भस्म हो गए। देवराज इंद्र, ब्रह्मा आदि देवताओं ने पुष्पवृष्टि की, उनके मृत पुत्र रोहिताश्व को जीवित कर दिया तथा उन्हें पुनः उनका अखंड राज्य और गौरव प्रदान किया। अंत में राजा अपने परिवार सहित परम पद को प्राप्त हुए।

॥ इति श्री अजा एकादशी व्रत कथा सम्पूर्णम् ॥

🌺 2026 कल्कि द्वादशी एवं विष्णुशृंखला महायोग

भाद्रपद शुक्ल द्वादशी को जब श्रवण नक्षत्र का पावन संयोग घटित होता है, तब शास्त्रों में इसे विष्णुशृंखला योग (Vishnushrinkhala Yoga) कहा जाता है। इस दिन भगवान श्रीहरि के भावी दसवें अवतार भगवान कल्कि तथा नर-नारायण रूप की पूजा की जाती है।

विष्णुशृंखला योग में किया गया द्वादशी व्रत करोड़ों जन्मों के पापों को नष्ट कर मोक्ष और वैकुंठ धाम की प्राप्ति कराता है।

ॐ नमो भगवते कल्किने वासुदेवाय नमः ।
म्लेच्छनिवहनिधने कलयसि करवालम् ।
धूमकेतुमिव किमपि करालम् ।
केशव धृतकल्किशरीर जय जगदीश हरे ॥

📖 कल्कि द्वादशी व्रत कथा: राजा विशाल और भगवान नर-नारायण (बद्री विशाल)

श्रीमद् वराह पुराण में वर्णित कथा के अनुसार, प्राचीन काल में राजा विशाल ने हिमालय के बदरीवन में भगवान श्री विष्णु को प्रसन्न करने हेतु घोर तपस्या की। उनकी तपस्या से संतुष्ट होकर साक्षात भगवान नर और नारायण ऋषि रूप में प्रकट हुए।

राजा विशाल ने जब उनके स्वरूप की महिमा पूछी, तो भगवान नर ने बताया कि वे स्वयं जगत्पालक नारायण हैं जो युग-युग में धर्म की रक्षा के लिए मत्स्य, कूर्म, वराह, नृसिंह, वामन, राम, कृष्ण तथा कलियुग के अंत में कल्कि अवतार धारण करते हैं।

महर्षि नर ने राजा विशाल को भाद्रपद शुक्ल द्वादशी का विधिवत व्रत करने का उपदेश दिया। राजा विशाल ने उस पावन विष्णुशृंखला योग में द्वादशी का उपवास रखा। इस व्रत के प्रभाव से वह स्थान समस्त लोकों में 'बद्री विशाल' (बद्रीनाथ धाम) के नाम से अमर हो गया और राजा को सर्वसुख, संतान और मोक्ष की प्राप्ति हुई।

॥ इति श्री कल्कि द्वादशी व्रत कथा सम्पूर्णम् ॥

🥗 पारण समय एवं संगव काल निषेध नियम

🌺 2026 परिवर्तिनी (पार्श्व/जयंती) एकादशी माहात्म्य

भाद्रपद मास के शुक्ल पक्ष की एकादशी को परिवर्तिनी एकादशी (Parivartini Ekadashi) अथवा पार्श्व एकादशी और जयंती एकादशी कहा जाता है।

चातुर्मास में योगनिद्रा में शयन करते हुए भगवान श्री विष्णु इस दिन करवट बदलते हैं (एक करवट से दूसरी करवट लेते हैं), इसलिए इसे 'परिवर्तिनी' कहा जाता है। इस दिन भगवान के वामन अवतार की पूजा, दही, चावल और चांदी के दान का विशेष महत्व है।

ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय नमः ।
देवेश्वराय देवाय देवसम्भूतिहेतवे ।
नमस्ते विष्णवे विष्णो शयनं परिवर्त्यताम् ॥

📖 परिवर्तिनी एकादशी व्रत कथा: भगवान वामन और दानवीर राजा बलि

भगवान श्रीकृष्ण ने अर्जुन को बताया कि त्रेतायुग में दैत्यराज बलि परम विष्णुभक्त और महादानी थे, किंतु उन्होंने अपने पराक्रम से तीनों लोकों और देवराज इंद्र के स्वर्ग पर अधिकार कर लिया था। देवताओं की प्रार्थना पर भगवान विष्णु ने महर्षि कश्यप और माता अदिति के यहां वामन अवतार धारण किया।

बटुक ब्राह्मण रूप धरे भगवान वामन राजा बलि के यज्ञ में पहुंचे और दान स्वरूप केवल तीन पग भूमि की याचना की। शुक्राचार्य के मना करने पर भी राजा बलि ने तीन पग भूमि दान करने का संकल्प ले लिया।

संकल्प लेते ही भगवान वामन ने विराट त्रिविक्रम रूप धारण कर लिया। उन्होंने एक पग में संपूर्ण पृथ्वीलोक तथा दूसरे पग में अंतरिक्ष व स्वर्गलोक नाप लिया। जब तीसरा पग रखने के लिए कोई स्थान न बचा, तो दानवीर राजा बलि ने हाथ जोड़कर अपना शीश भगवान के चरणों में झुका दिया।

भगवान ने बलि के मस्तक पर अपना पग रखकर उन्हें पाताल लोक (सुतल लोक) का अधिपति बना दिया और उनकी भक्ति से प्रसन्न होकर वरदान दिया कि भाद्रपद शुक्ल एकादशी के दिन उनका एक स्वरूप पाताल में राजा बलि की रक्षा करेगा और दूसरा स्वरूप क्षीरसागर में शेषनाग पर शयन करते हुए करवट बदलेगा।

॥ इति श्री परिवर्तिनी एकादशी व्रत कथा सम्पूर्णम् ॥

🌺 2026 इन्दिरा एकादशी माहात्म्य एवं पितृ मुक्ति

आश्विन मास के कृष्ण पक्ष में आने वाली एकादशी को इन्दिरा एकादशी (Indira Ekadashi) कहा जाता है। यह एकादशी पितृ पक्ष (श्राद्ध पक्ष) के दौरान आती है, इसलिए इसका धार्मिक व आध्यात्मिक महत्व अत्यंत पावन और विशेष है। मान्यता है कि इस दिन व्रत रखने और उसका पुण्य फल अपने पितरों को समर्पित करने से यमलोक में कष्ट भोग रहे पितृ-पूर्वजों को तत्काल मुक्ति मिल जाती है और वे वैकुण्ठ धाम को गमन करते हैं।

भगवान श्रीकृष्ण ने धर्मराज युधिष्ठिर एवं अर्जुन को इन्दिरा एकादशी का माहात्म्य सुनाते हुए कहा था कि इस पावन व्रत के प्रभाव से बड़े से बड़े पापों का नाश होता है तथा मनुष्य कोटि-कुलों का उद्धार कर मोक्ष का भागी बनता है।

📖 इन्दिरा एकादशी व्रत कथा (Vrat Katha Indira Ekadashi)

राजा इंद्रसेन के पिता की यमलोक से मुक्ति की अमर कथा

॥ आश्विन कृष्ण इन्दिरा एकादशी माहात्म्य कथा ॥

सत्ययुग में महिष्मती नामक रमणीक नगरी में इंद्रसेन नाम के एक प्रतापी, धर्मनिष्ठ और शूरवीर राजा राज्य करते थे। राजा इंद्रसेन भगवान विष्णु के परम भक्त थे। उनका राज्य धन-धान्य और प्रजा-सुख से परिपूर्ण था। एक दिन जब राजा अपनी राजसभा में विराजमान थे, तभी देवर्षि नारद आकाशमार्ग से वीणा बजाते हुए राजा के दरबार में पधारे।

राजा इंद्रसेन ने हाथ जोड़कर देवर्षि का यथोचित पूजन-सत्कार किया। तब देवर्षि नारद ने कहा— "हे राजन्! मैं यमलोक गया था, वहाँ मैंने तुम्हारे पिता को देखा। वे अपने पूर्वजन्म के किसी कर्म-दोष के कारण यमराज के लोक में कष्ट पा रहे हैं। उन्होंने मुझसे कहा कि मेरे पुत्र इंद्रसेन से कहना कि वह आश्विन कृष्ण पक्ष की इन्दिरा एकादशी का व्रत करे और उस व्रत का पुण्य मुझे समर्पित कर दे, जिससे मेरा यमलोक से उद्धार होकर स्वर्ग अथवा वैकुण्ठ की प्राप्ति हो सके।"

राजा इंद्रसेन ने विनीत भाव से पूछा— "हे मुनिश्रेष्ठ! कृपया मुझे इन्दिरा एकादशी के व्रत की संपूर्ण विधि बताइए।" तब नारद जी ने बताया— "हे राजन्! आश्विन कृष्ण दशमी के दिन पवित्र नदी में स्नान करके मध्याह्न में पितरों का तर्पण करना चाहिए। एकादशी के दिन प्रातः स्नानादि से निवृत्त होकर भगवान शालिग्राम का षोडशोपचार पूजन करो, निर्जल अथवा फलाहार व्रत रखो। ब्राह्मणों को भोजन कराकर दक्षिणा दो तथा अपने पिता के निमित्त व्रत का संपूर्ण पुण्य फल समर्पित कर दो।"

राजा इंद्रसेन ने बंधु-बांधवों सहित देवर्षि नारद के कथनानुसार भक्तिभाव से इन्दिरा एकादशी का पूर्ण विधि से व्रत किया और उसका पुण्य अपने पिता को अर्पित किया। ऐसा करते ही आकाश से पुष्पों की वर्षा होने लगी, राजा के पिता दिव्य गरुड़ वाहन पर आरूढ़ होकर वैकुण्ठ धाम चले गए और राजा इंद्रसेन भी अंत समय में निष्कंटक राज्य भोगकर भगवान के परम पद को प्राप्त हुए।

Legends of Indira Ekadashi (पावन पौराणिक सनातन कथा)

Arjuna, filled with devotion for Lord Krishna, said - "O Lord! Please tell me the story of the Ekadashi that occurs during the Krishna Paksha of Ashwina month. What is the name of this Ekadashi, and what benefits can be attained by observing it? Please explain with details."

Lord Krishna said to Arjuna - "O Dhanurdhara! The Ekadashi that occurs during the Krishna Paksha of Ashwina month is called Indira Ekadashi. By observing the fast on this Ekadashi, all sins are cleansed and those ancestors who have descended into hell are liberated. O Arjuna, simply by listening to the story of this Ekadashi, one can attain infinite rewards. I will narrate this story to you, so please listen attentively -

In the Satya Yuga, there was a city named Mahishmati, which was ruled by a powerful king named Indrasena. He was blessed with sons, grandsons, wealth and a prosperous kingdom. His enemies were always fearful of him. One day, while the king was sitting comfortably in his royal court, Maharishi Narada arrived. On seeing Narada, the king rose from his seat, showed his respect and offered him a seat of honor. Then Maharishi Narada said - "O king! Is everything well in your kingdom? I am very pleased to see your righteousness."

The king said - "O divine sage! By your grace, everything is well in my kingdom and all my Yajna Karma and other deeds have been successful. O Maharishi, please tell me the purpose of your arrival here. What service can I offer you?"

Maharishi Narada said - "O, noble king! I was greatly astonished to see your father seated in the assembly of Yamaraja when I visited the realm of death from Brahmaloka. Your father was a wise, charitable and pious man, but due to his violation of the Ekadashi fast, he ended up in the realm of Yama. He has sent a message to you."

The king asked eagerly - "What is the message, Maharishi? Please tell me as soon as possible."

Narada told the king, that his father said - "Maharishi! please deliver a message to my son Indrasena, the king of Mahishmati city. Due to my sinful deeds in a past life, I have found myself in this realm. If my son observes the fast of Indira Ekadashi during the Krishna Paksha of Ashwina month and donates the merit of this fast to me, I will be liberated. This will allow me to be free from this realm and reside in heaven."

On hearing that his father was suffering in the Yamaloka, Indrasena felt a deep sadness. He said to Narada - "O Narada, it is truly distressing to learn that my father is in Yamaloka. I am determined to take steps to liberate him. Please kindly explain to me the procedures for observing the Indira Ekadashi fast."

Narada Ji said - "O King! On the tenth day of the Krishna Paksha in the month of Ashwina, one should take a spiritual bath early in the morning. After this, it is recommended to take a bath once again at noon. Following the second bath, one should perform the Shraddha ceremony for their ancestors and have only one meal that day. At night, one should sleep on the floor. On the next day, which is Ekadashi, after completing your daily duties and taking a bath, observe the fast with devotion. Make a resolution as follows - "Today, I will abstain from food and give up all forms of enjoyment. I will eat on the following day. O Lord, you are my protector. Please assist me in completing my fast."

After that, In the afternoon, establish the idol of Lord Shaligrama and invite a Brahmin for a meal, offering him Daskhina.

Set aside a portion of the food for a cow. Worship Lord Vishnu with Dhupa, Naivedya, etc and stay awake throughout the night. On the day of Dwadashi, observe silence and share a meal with your relatives. O King! This is the method of observing the fast of Indira Ekadashi. By diligently following this fast and avoiding laziness, you will ensure that your father becomes eligible to reside in heaven."

Narada explained all the rituals to the king and then disappeared. When Indira Ekadashi arrived, the king observed the fast according to all its prescribed rites. As a result of fasting alongside his relatives, flowers rained down from the sky and the king's father ascended to heaven on a chariot, leaving the Yamaloka.

Due to the influence of this Ekadashi, King Indrasena also enjoyed happiness in this world and eventually ascended to heaven."

Lord Krishna said - "O friend! I have described the greatness of Indira Ekadashi to you. By merely reading and listening to this story, all sins are absolved and one becomes eligible to reside in heaven in the end."

Regardless of the vow a person makes, they should fulfill it with their body, mind and soul. It should be done wholeheartedly. One should never break a vow made for any task.

According to Purnimanta calendar, Ashwina Krishna Paksha Ekadashi and according to Amanta Hindu calendar, Bhadrapada Krishna Paksha Ekadashi is known as Indira Ekadashi. By observing this fast, the ancestors get freedom and salvation from the troubles of Yama Loka.

Aarti is one of the most important rituals of worshipping any deity. Ekadashi Aarti is a prayer dedicated to Goddess Ekadashi. This Aarti can be sung during Ekadashi fasting and on various occasions related to Ekadashi.

It is believed that Vaikuntha Dwaram is opened on this day and devotees who observe fast on Vaikuntha Ekadashi attain salvation. This is a popular Ekadashi in Tamil calendar. Vaikuntha Ekadashi is also known as Mukkoti Ekadashi.

🥗 Ekadashi Fasting Food (एकादशी फलाहार नियम)

इन्दिरा एकादशी व्रत में अन्न, चावल, दालें, लहसुन, प्याज तथा तामसिक खाद्य सर्वथा वर्जित हैं। फलाहार के रूप में कुट्टू का आटा, सिंघाड़े का आटा, साबूदाना, सावां के चावल, आलू, शकरकंद, मूंगफली, सेंधा नमक, दूध, दही, घी तथा सभी ताजे फल ग्रहण किए जा सकते हैं।

❓ Ekadashi Fasting FAQ (अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले प्रश्न)

प्रश्न: इन्दिरा एकादशी का पारणा कब और कैसे करें?
उत्तर: 7 अक्टूबर 2026 को प्रातः 06:17 AM से 08:38 AM के मध्य श्रीहरि का पूजन कर ब्राह्मण अथवा जरूरतमंद को भोजन या दान देकर पारणा करें।

प्रश्न: क्या पितृ पक्ष में एकादशी का श्राद्ध किया जा सकता है?
उत्तर: हाँ, एकादशी तिथि का श्राद्ध एकादशी के दिन किया जाता है, परंतु इस दिन केवल फलाहारी पदार्थों का ही भोग व दान पितरों के निमित्त लगाना शास्त्रसम्मत है।

✨ Indira Ekadashi - ISKCON Tradition

इस्कॉन (ISKCON) तथा गौड़ीय वैष्णव परंपरा में इन्दिरा एकादशी को विशुद्ध हरि-भक्ति तथा नाम-संकीर्तन के साथ मनाया जाता है। भक्तगण दिनभर हरे कृष्ण महामंत्र का जप करते हैं और समस्त पुण्य श्रील प्रभुपाद एवं पूर्व आचार्यों के माध्यम से श्रीहरि को समर्पित करते हैं।

🌺 2026 पापांकुशा एकादशी माहात्म्य

आश्विन मास के शुक्ल पक्ष की एकादशी को पापांकुशा एकादशी (Papankusha Ekadashi) कहा जाता है। 'पापांकुशा' का अर्थ है जो पाप रूपी मदमस्त हाथी को अंकुश लगाकर वश में कर ले और विनष्ट कर दे। इस पावन तिथि पर भगवान पद्मनाभ (श्रीहरि विष्णु) की पूजा की जाती है। इस व्रत को करने से मनुष्य के कोटि जन्मों के संचित पाप भस्म हो जाते हैं और वह स्वर्गलोक का अधिकारी बनता है।

📖 पापांकुशा एकादशी व्रत कथा (Vrat Katha Papankusha Ekadashi)

भगवान श्रीकृष्ण द्वारा अर्जुन को पापांकुशा एकादशी का उपदेश एवं क्रोधना बहेलिये का उद्धार

॥ आश्विन शुक्ल पापांकुशा एकादशी पावन प्रसंग ॥

प्राचीन काल में विंध्याचल पर्वत पर 'क्रोधना' नाम का एक अत्यंत क्रूर और पापी बहेलिया रहता था। उसने अपने संपूर्ण जीवन में हिंसा, चोरी, मद्यपान और असत्य के अतिरिक्त कोई पुण्य कर्म नहीं किया था। जब उसका अंत समय निकट आया, तब यमराज ने अपने दूतों को आज्ञा दी कि क्रोधना को कल यमलोक ले आओ।

यमदूतों की छाया और मृत्यु का साक्षात भय देखकर बहेलिया भयभीत होकर कांपने लगा। वह अपनी जान बचाने के लिए महर्षि अंगिरा के आश्रम में पहुंचा और मुनि के चरणों में गिरकर विलाप करने लगा— "हे दयालु मुनिवर! मैंने जीवनभर केवल पाप किए हैं। कल यमदूत मुझे घसीटकर नरक ले जाएंगे। कृपा करके मुझे कोई ऐसा उपाय बताइए जिससे मुझे घोर नरक की यातनाओं से मुक्ति मिल सके।"

महर्षि अंगिरा ने उस पर कृपा करते हुए कहा— "हे व्याध! डरो मत। आज आश्विन शुक्ल पक्ष की पापांकुशा एकादशी है। तुम विधिपूर्वक निराहार रहकर भगवान विष्णु की पूजा करो और एकादशी का व्रत धारण करो। यह एकादशी समस्त पापों पर अंकुश लगाकर उनका संहार करने वाली है।"

बहेलिये ने महर्षि के वचनों का पालन करते हुए पापांकुशा एकादशी का पूर्ण श्रद्धा से व्रत किया और रात्रि जागरण कर श्रीहरि के नाम का कीर्तन किया। एकादशी के पुण्य प्रभाव से उसके जीवनभर के समस्त पाप तत्काल क्षीण हो गए। जब अगले दिन यमदूत आए, तो भगवान विष्णु के पार्षदों ने उसे दिव्य विमान में बिठाकर सीधे वैकुण्ठ धाम पहुंचा दिया।

Legends of Papankusha Ekadashi (पावन पौराणिक सनातन कथा)

Arjuna asked, "O Lord of the Universe! What is the name of the Ekadashi that occurs during the Shukla Paksha of Ashwina month? What are the benefits of observing this fast? Please explain this in detail."

Lord Shri Krishna said - "Kuntinandana! The name of the Ekadashi that occurs during the Shukla Paksha of Ashwina month is Papankusha Ekadashi. By observing this fast, all sins are destroyed, and the person who observes the fast receives eternal merit.

On this Ekadashi, one should worship Lord Vishnu to attain the desired results. By performing this worship, one can earn a heavenly reward. O, Arjuna! Those who achieve fruits through rigorous penances will receive the same benefits by bowing to Lord Vishnu, who reclines on Sheshnaga in the Milky Ocean, on this Ekadashi day. They will not endure the torments of Yama, the god of death. O, Partha! Devotees of Vishnu who criticise Lord Shiva, or devotees of Shiva who criticise Lord Vishnu, will ultimately face the consequences in hell.

The benefits of observing the Papankusha Ekadashi fast far exceed those of performing a thousand Ashwamedha Yajnas and a hundred Rajasuya Yajnas combined. The merit gained from this fast is more than one-sixteenth of their total fruit. Therefore, there is no other fast in the world that can compare to the Papankusha Ekadashi fast.

No day in the world is as sacred as this Ekadashi. Those who do not observe the Ekadashi fast are often burdened by sins. Anyone who, for any reason, observes this particular Ekadashi fast will be spared from facing Yama, the god of death.

Observing the Ekadashi fast leads to a healthy body, a beautiful spouse and wealth and prosperity. Ultimately, it allows one to reach heaven. Those who stay awake during the night of this Ekadashi fast can easily attain heaven.

Observing the Ekadashi fast allows individuals to elevate the spirits of ten ancestors from their mother's side, ten from their father's side and ten from their spouse's side. These ancestors, adorned with beautiful ornaments and taking on the form of Lord Vishnu, are believed to have ascended to the Vishnu Loka.

The one who observe the Papankusha Ekadashi fast during the Shukla Paksha in the month of Ashwina, while following the prescribed rituals, will attain Vishnu Loka.

Furthermore, those who donate items such as land, cows, food, water, footwear, clothes and umbrellas on the day of Ekadashi will not have to face Yama, the god of death.

Even individuals with limited financial means should strive to earn merit by making donations according to their capacity.

Those who build ponds, gardens, guest houses, water stations and similar contributions do not suffer the torments of hell. Such people enjoy a healthy and long life, have children and experience wealth and prosperity in this world. Ultimately, they reach heaven and by the grace of Lord Shri Hari, they avoid misfortune."

A person should firmly resolve to stay away from sinful actions. While meditating on and remembering Lord Vishnu in any form is beneficial and helps to remove sins, on the day of Ekadashi, recalling and singing the praises of the Lord alleviates all suffering and eliminates sins.

According to the Hindu calendar, Shukla Paksha Ekadashi Ashwina month is known as Papankusha Ekadashi. According to Hindu scriptures, the merit of a thousand Ashvamedha and a hundred Rajasuya Yajnas is not even equal to one sixteenth of this Ekadashi.

🌺 2026 रमा एकादशी माहात्म्य (कार्तिक कृष्ण एकादशी)

कार्तिक मास के कृष्ण पक्ष की एकादशी को रमा एकादशी (Rama Ekadashi) कहा जाता है। माता लक्ष्मी का एक पावन नाम 'रमा' भी है, इसलिए यह एकादशी माता लक्ष्मी एवं भगवान केशव की कृपा प्राप्त करने का सर्वोत्तम अवसर है। यह एकादशी दीपावली महापर्व से चार दिन पूर्व आती है, जिससे घर में सुख, समृद्धि और ऐश्वर्य की वृद्धि होती है।

📖 रमा एकादशी व्रत कथा (Vrat Katha Rama Ekadashi)

राजा मुचुकुंद, शोभन और चंद्रभागा की पावन कथा

॥ कार्तिक कृष्ण रमा एकादशी अमर कथा ॥

प्राचीन काल में मुचुकुंद नाम के एक धर्मात्मा राजा राज्य करते थे। उनकी एक रूपवती और गुणवती कन्या थी, जिसका नाम चंद्रभागा था। चंद्रभागा का विवाह राजा चंद्रसेन के पुत्र शोभन के साथ हुआ। शोभन स्वभाव से अत्यंत दुर्बल और शारीरिक रूप से कमजोर था, भूख सहन करने में सर्वथा असमर्थ था।

एक बार शोभन अपनी ससुराल आया, उसी समय कार्तिक मास की रमा एकादशी की तिथि आ गई। राजा मुचुकुंद के राज्य में कड़ा नियम था कि एकादशी के दिन राज्य के सभी मनुष्य, यहाँ तक कि पशु-पक्षी भी अन्न ग्रहण नहीं कर सकते थे। शोभन ने अपनी पत्नी चंद्रभागा से कहा— "हे प्रिये! मैं भूख से व्याकुल होकर मर जाऊंगा, मुझे बताओ मैं क्या करूं?" चंद्रभागा ने कहा— "हे स्वामी! मेरे पिता के राज्य में किसी को भी अन्न खाने की अनुमति नहीं है। यदि आप जीवित रहना चाहते हैं, तो नगर से बाहर चले जाएं या भगवान पर भरोसा रखकर व्रत करें।"

शोभन ने व्रत रखने का निश्चय किया। दिनभर वह किसी प्रकार शांत रहा, परंतु जैसे ही रात्रि हुई, भूख और प्यास की भयंकर पीड़ा से शोभन के प्राण निकल गए। राजा मुचुकुंद और चंद्रभागा ने विलाप करते हुए उसका दाह-संस्कार कराया। चंद्रभागा सती नहीं हुई और अपने पिता के घर रहकर नियमित एकादशी व्रत करने लगी।

रमा एकादशी के पावन प्रभाव से शोभन को मंदराचल पर्वत पर अत्यंत दिव्य, विशाल और अलौकिक देवपुरी का राज्य प्राप्त हुआ। किंतु वह नगर अस्थिर (अस्थाई) था क्योंकि शोभन ने विवशतावश व्रत किया था। जब मुचुकुंद के नगर का एक सोमशर्मा नाम का ब्राह्मण तीर्थयात्रा करते हुए वहां पहुंचा, तो उसने शोभन को पहचान लिया। शोभन ने कहा— "यह राज्य मुझे रमा एकादशी के पुण्य से मिला है, परंतु यह अस्थिर है। यदि मेरी पत्नी चंद्रभागा अपने वर्षों के संचित एकादशी व्रतों का पुण्य मुझे समर्पित कर दे, तो यह नगर चिरस्थाई हो जाएगा।"

ब्राह्मण ने लौटकर यह बात चंद्रभागा को बताई। चंद्रभागा अत्यंत हर्षित हुई और महर्षि वामदेव के आश्रम में जाकर दिव्य संस्कार प्राप्त कर मंदराचल पर्वत पर पहुंची। उसने अपने जीवनभर के एकादशी व्रतों का संपूर्ण पुण्य शोभन को अर्पित कर दिया। उस महान पुण्य के प्रभाव से शोभन का वह दिव्य नगर अखंड और स्थिर हो गया, और दोनों दिव्य दंपत्ति अनंत काल तक श्रीहरि के धाम में आनंदपूर्वक निवास करने लगे।

Legends of Rama Ekadashi (पावन पौराणिक सनातन कथा)

Emotionally overwhelmed, Arjuna exclaimed - "O Shri Krishna! Please share with me the story of the Ekadashi that occurs during Krishna Paksha in the month of Kartika. What is the name of this Ekadashi and which deity is worshipped on this day? What are the benefits of observing the fast on this Ekadashi? I kindly request a detailed explanation."

Lord Shri Krishna said - "O Arjuna! The name of the Ekadashi that occurs during the Krishna Paksha in the month of Kartika is Rama Ekadashi. Observing this fast removes all sins. Listen carefully to its story -

In ancient times, there was a king named Muchukunda who ruled over his kingdom.

Indra, Varuna, Kubera, Vibhishana, and others were his friends. He was known for his unwavering truthfulness and devotion to Lord Vishnu. His kingdom was entirely free of troubles. He had a daughter named Chandrabhaga, who was married to Shobhana, the son of King Chandrasena. King Muchukunda observed the Ekadashi fast with great discipline and everyone in his kingdom strictly followed this practice.

Once, Shobhana visited his in-laws' house during the month of Kartika. This was the time of the highly meritorious Rama Ekadashi, a day when everyone observed a fast. Chandrabhaga, Shobhana's wife, was concerned that her husband might be too weak to observe the Ekadashi fast, especially since her father had mandated that all must fast on this day. In response to her worries, the king declared an order that everyone in the kingdom must strictly observe the Ekadashi fast, particularly since his son-in-law was present. When the Dashami Tithi arrived, the announcement was made throughout the kingdom. Hearing this, Shobhana approached his wife and said - "O dear! Please suggest a solution for me, because I cannot fast. If I attempt to fast, I will surely die."

Listening to her husband, Chandrabhaga replied - "O dear! In my father's kingdom, no one is allowed to eat on the day of Ekadashi. Even the elephants, horses, camels, and other animals don't consume grass, grains, or water, so how can humans eat? If you cannot fast, you should go somewhere else. If you stay here, you will definitely have to observe the fast."

Listening to his wife, Shobhana said - "O dear! Your suggestion is valid, but I will not go anywhere else, even if it means I have to fast. I am determined to observe this fast, regardless of the outcome. After all, who can avoid what is written in destiny?"

Along with everyone else, Shobhana observed the Ekadashi fast and became extremely distressed from hunger and thirst.

When the Sun set, the night for staying awake began. That night brought unbearable suffering to Shobhana and before sunrise the following day, he passed away due to the hunger and thirst.

The king had Shobhana's body released into the water and instructed his daughter not to become a Sati and to have faith in the Lord Vishnu.

Following her father's instructions, Chandrabhaga chose not to become a Sati. Instead, she stayed at her father's house and continued to observe the Ekadashi fast.

Due to the auspicious occasion of Rama Ekadashi, Shobhana was lifted from the water and, by the grace of Lord Vishnu, was granted a magnificent city named Devapura on Mount Mandarachala. This city was filled with wealth and was free from enemies. Shobhana was made the king of Devapura, and his palace was adorned with pillars made of gems and gold. Dressed in beautiful clothes and ornaments, King Shobhana sat on a throne crafted from gold and precious stones. Gandharvas and Apsaras danced and praised him. At that moment, King Shobhana radiated the majesty of another Indra. At this time, a Brahmin named Soma Sharma, hailing from the city of Muchukunda, set out on a pilgrimage. While wandering, he arrived in King Shobhana's kingdom and encountered him. Recognising Shobhana as King's son-in-law, the Brahmin approached the king. Noticing Soma Sharma, King Shobhana rose from his throne to inquire about the well-being of his father-in-law and his wife, Chandrabhaga. Upon hearing Shobhana's questions, Soma Sharma responded - "O King! Our king is fine, and your wife, Chandrabhaga, is also doing well. Now, please tell me your story. You left your body because you could not consume food and water on the day of Rama Ekadashi. I am greatly amased to see such a wondrous and beautiful city, one the likes of which I have never heard of or seen. How did you come to attain this?"

Shobhana replied - "O Lord! This splendid city is the result of observing the Rama Ekadashi fast during the Krishna Paksha of Kartika month. However, this city is unstable."

Upon hearing Shobhana, the Brahmin asked - "O King! Why is it unstable, and how can it be stabilised? Please explain this to me. If there is anything I can do to stabilise it, I will certainly do so." King Shobhana responded - "O Brahmin Deva! I observed the fast unwillingly and without devotion. As a result, I received this unstable city. However, if you convey this account to Chandrabhaga, the daughter of King Muchukunda, she can help stabilise it."

On hearing King Shobhana's words, the Brahmin returned to his city and recounted the entire story to Chandrabhaga. In response, Chandrabhaga asked - "O Brahmin Deva! Did you witness all these events with your own eyes, or are you describing a dream?"

The Brahmin replied - "O princess! I have seen your husband Shobhana and his city with my own eyes, but the city is unstable. You should find a way to make it stable."

Listening to the Brahmin, Chandrabhaga said - "O, learned Brahmin! Please take me to that city. I wish to see my husband. I will stabilize that city with the power of my fast."

On hearing Chandrabhaga, the Brahmin took her to the Ashrama of Vamadeva, located near Mount Mandarachala. After hearing her story, Vamadeva performed a ceremonial ablution with Mantras. Through the power of these Mantras and her fasting, Chandrabhaga acquired a divine form and went to her husband.

Shobhana, upon seeing his wife Chandrabhaga, joyfully welcomed her to sit next to him.

Chandrabhaga said - "O My lord! listen to the merit I have earned. From the age of eight, while living with my father, I faithfully observed the Ekadashi fast with all the prescribed rituals. The merit gained from these fasts will ensure the stability of your city, the stability that will last eternally and fulfill all its purposes." Radiant in her divine form, adorned with divine garments and jewellery, Chandrabhaga happily resided with her husband. O Arjuna, this is the greatness of Rama Ekadashi. All sins are eradicated for those who observe this fast. And those who hear the glorification of Rama Ekadashi will attain Vishnu Loka after death."

Lord Shri Hari is extremely compassionate and forgiving. Even if someone worships Him or observes the Ekadashi fast either devotedly or out of compulsion, He still grants them excellent results. However, one should always worship the God with full devotion.

Shobhana was able to stabilise his kingdom due to the Ekadashi fasts observed by his wife Chandrabhaga with full devotion. Such a virtuous wife can only be obtained by the grace of Lord Shri Hari.

According to the Purnimanta Hindu calendar, Kartika Krishna Paksha Ekadashi and according to the Amanta Hindu calendar, Ashwina Krishna Paksha Ekadashi is observed as Rama Ekadashi. The effect of this fast removes all sins and leads to the attainment of Vishnu Loka.

Aarti is one of the most important rituals of worshipping any deity. Ekadashi Aarti is a prayer dedicated to Goddess Ekadashi. This Aarti can be sung during Ekadashi fasting and on various occasions related to Ekadashi.

Goddess Ekadashi is considered as the Yoga Maya of Lord Vishnu. Utpanna Ekadashi is the greatest Ekadashi of all. On this day, Goddess Ekadashi was manifested to kill demon named Mura.

It is believed that Vaikuntha Dwaram is opened on this day and devotees who observe fast on Vaikuntha Ekadashi attain salvation. This is a popular Ekadashi in Tamil calendar. Vaikuntha Ekadashi is also known as Mukkoti Ekadashi.

Nirjala Ekadashi is one of the twenty four Ekadashi Vrats which are observed to receive the special grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu. Consumption of water is prohibited during this fast. By observing the fast of Nirjala Ekadashi, one gets the virtuous results of all the 24 Ekadashis.

Prabodhini Ekadashi is one of the twenty four Ekadashi Vrats which are observed to receive special grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu. According to Hindu beliefs, on this day Lord Vishnu wakes up from four months of Yogic sleep. It is also known as the Dev Uthani Ekadashi and Devutthaan Ekadashi.

According to the Purnimanta Hindu calendar, Margashirsha Krishna Paksha Ekadashi and according to the Amanta Hindu calendar, Kartika Krishna Paksha Ekadashi is known as Utpanna Ekadashi. Ekadashi fasting is started from Utpanna Ekadashi.

🌺 2026 देवउठनी एकादशी (प्रबोधिनी एकादशी) माहात्म्य व तुलसी विवाह

कार्तिक मास के शुक्ल पक्ष की एकादशी को देवउठनी एकादशी, देव प्रबोधिनी एकादशी या देवोत्थान एकादशी कहा जाता है। आषाढ़ शुक्ल एकादशी (देवशयनी) को क्षीरसागर में चार मास के लिए योगनिद्रा में शयन करने वाले जगत के पालनहार भगवान श्रीहरि विष्णु इसी पावन तिथि को अपनी योगनिद्रा से जागते हैं।

भगवान के जागने के साथ ही चार महीने का चातुर्मास व्रत संपन्न होता है और समस्त मांगलिक कार्य जैसे विवाह, मुंडन, यज्ञोपवीत, गृह प्रवेश आदि पुनः प्रारंभ हो जाते हैं। इसी पावन तिथि से तुलसी विवाह का महापर्व भी प्रारंभ होता है, जिसमें शालिग्राम भगवान और माता तुलसी का विवाह अत्यंत धूमधाम से कराया जाता है।

📖 प्रबोधिनी एकादशी व्रत कथा (Vrat Katha Prabodhini Ekadashi)

देवर्षि नारद और ब्रह्मा जी का पावन संवाद

॥ कार्तिक शुक्ल प्रबोधिनी एकादशी अमर महात्म्य ॥

देवर्षि नारद ने पितामह ब्रह्मा जी से विनीत भाव से पूछा— "हे पितामह! कृपया मुझे कार्तिक मास के शुक्ल पक्ष की प्रबोधिनी एकादशी के व्रत का माहात्म्य सुनाइए।" ब्रह्मा जी ने कहा— "हे मुनिश्रेष्ठ नारद! प्रबोधिनी एकादशी समस्त पापों को हरने वाली, ज्ञान और मुक्ति देने वाली तथा अक्षय पुण्य प्रदान करने वाली है। जो फल एक हजार अश्वमेध यज्ञ और सौ राजसूय यज्ञ करने से मिलता है, वह केवल इस एकादशी के उपवास से सुलभ हो जाता है।"

ब्रह्मा जी ने आगे कहा— "हे नारद! जो व्यक्ति इस दिन भक्तिपूर्वक भगवान विष्णु का पूजन करता है, उसके कई जन्मों के संचित घोर पाप भी एक क्षण में जलकर भस्म हो जाते हैं। इस दिन गंगा, यमुना, गोदावरी आदि सभी पवित्र नदियां उसी घर में वास करती हैं जहां प्रबोधिनी एकादशी का रात्रि-जागरण और हरि-संकीर्तन होता है। इस दिन गन्ने का मंडप बनाकर भगवान शालिग्राम का षोडशोपचार पूजन करना चाहिए तथा शंखध्वनि और घंटानाद के साथ 'उत्तिष्ठ उत्तिष्ठ गोविंद त्यज निद्रां जगत्पते' कहकर प्रभु को जगाना चाहिए।"

Legends of Prabodhini Ekadashi (पावन पौराणिक सनातन कथा)

Lord Krishna said - "O Arjuna! You are my very dear friend. O Partha! Now, I will tell you the story of Prabodhini Ekadashi, which eliminates sins and bestows merit and liberation. Listen with faith -

In this context, I will share the conversation that took place between Devarshi Narada and Lord Brahma. Once, Narada Ji asked Brahma Ji - "O father! What is the benefit of observing the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast? Please explain the procedure in detail."

Brahma Ji said - "O son! The reward for observing the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast during the Shukla Paksha of the Kartika month is equivalent to the merit gained from performing a thousand Ashvamedha Yajnas and a hundred Rajasuya Yajnas."

Narada Ji replied - "O father! What are the benefits of eating one meal in the evening, eating at night and fasting throughout the day? Please explain in detail."

Brahma Ji said - "O Narada! Eating one meal in the evening can erase the sins of two lifetimes while fasting throughout the day can eliminate the sins of seven lifetimes. That which is difficult to attain in the three worlds can be easily acquired by observing the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast. This fast has the power to instantly destroy even the greatest of sins. By observing the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast, many sinful deeds from past lives can be obliterated in a moment.

Those who observe the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast according to their nature and follow the proper procedures will reap the full benefit.

O son! The merit gained by those who perform even a few virtuous deeds on this day with faith becomes as steadfast as a mountain.

Those who sincerely contemplate within their hearts the desire to observe the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast will have the sins accumulated from a hundred lifetimes erased.

Those who perform a night vigil on Prabodhini Ekadashi will ensure that their past and future ten generations reside in Vishnu Loka. Furthermore, their ancestors, who have suffered many hardships in hell, will also attain Vishnu Loka and experience happiness.

O Narada! Even the gravest sins, such as Brahmahatya, are absolved by observing a night vigil on the occasion of Prabodhini Ekadashi. The rewards of maintaining this vigil on Prabodhini Ekadashi are greater than the benefits derived from sacrifices like the Ashvamedha.

The fruits of undertaking all pilgrimages and donating cows, gold, land and other offerings are equivalent to the rewards gained from observing the night vigil on Prabodhini.

My son, in this world, the life of a person is truly successful if they purify their lineage by observing the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast. All the pilgrimages in the world and all those pilgrimages that can be hoped for reside in the home of the one who observes the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast.

A person should indeed observe the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast in the month of Kartika, setting aside all other activities to gratify Lord Shri Hari. Those who keep this Ekadashi fast will become wealthy, attain the status of a yogi, live as an ascetic and gain mastery over their senses. This observance is highly regarded by Narada and Lord Vishnu. As a result of this fast, a person can free themselves from the cycle of birth and death.

Through the observance of this Ekadashi fast, the sins of all three kinds - physical, verbal and mental are alleviated. Those who engage in charity, penance, oblations, sacrifices and other virtuous acts on this Ekadashi for the attainment of Lord Vishnu will receive boundless blessings.

On the day of Prabodhini Ekadashi, worshipping Lord Shri Hari leads to the destruction of all sins, both from youth and old age. The reward for observing a vigil on the night of this Ekadashi is a thousand times greater than the reward for bathing during a Surya Grahana. The merits a person earns throughout their life are insignificant compared to the merits gained from fasting on Prabodhini Ekadashi. Furthermore, all the merits of those who do not observe the fast on this day are rendered worthless.

Therefore, O son! You should also worship Lord Vishnu using the proper procedure. Those who are righteous and do not eat the food of others, receive the fruit of the Chandrayana fast in the month of Kartika.

In the month of Kartika, the Lord is not as pleased with charity, etc., as He is with listening to the stories of the scriptures.

In the month of Kartika, those who read or listen to even a little of the Lord's story receive the fruit of donating a hundred cows."

Hearing Brahma Ji's words, Narada Ji said - "O father! Now tell me the procedure of the Ekadashi fast and what merit is obtained by observing which kind of fast? Please explain this too."

On hearing Narada's words, Brahma Ji said - "O son! On this Ekadashi, a person should wake up during the Brahma Muhurat. After taking a bath and completing other rituals, one should resolve to fast. At that time, one should pray to Lord Vishnu, saying O Lord! Today I will refrain from food and will eat on the second day. Therefore, please protect me.

After this prayer, one should worship the Lord and begin the fast. The night should be spent near the Lord, engaging in singing, dancing, playing music and reciting stories and Kirtana.

On Prabodhini Ekadashi, one should set aside any stinginess and worship the Lord with many flowers, agarwood, incense and other offerings.

One should offer Arghya to the Lord with water from a conch shell. Its fruit is a crore times more than the donation of pilgrimages, etc.

Those who worship the Lord with Agastya flowers, even Indra folds his hands before them.

Those who worship the Lord with Bilva leaves in the month of Kartika attain liberation in the end.

Those who worship the Lord with Tulasi Ji in the month of Kartika have all the sins of ten thousand births destroyed.

Those who see, touch, meditate on, chant, plant or serve Shri Tulasi Ji in this month reside in the abode of Lord Vishnu for thousands of crores of Yugas.

Those who plant a Tulasi plant, those who are born in their lineage, reside in Vishnu Loka till the end of Pralaya, i.e., cosmic dissolution.

Those who worship the Lord with Kadamba flowers do not suffer the torments of Yamaraja. Lord Vishnu, who fulfills all desires, is very pleased to receive Kadamba flowers. There is nothing greater than worshipping Him with these flowers. Those who offer rose flowers to the Lord certainly attain liberation. Worshipping with Bakula and Ashoka flowers protects one from sorrow for an infinite time. When devotees worship Lord Vishnu with white and red Kanera flowers, the Lord is very pleased with them. If one worships Lord Shri Hari with Durva grass, they receive a hundred times more benefits than from regular worship. Those who offer Shami leaves find it easy to cross the dangerous path of Yamaraja. Lastly, those who worship Lord Vishnu with Champaka flowers are freed from the cycle of life and death.

Those who offer golden Ketaki flowers to the Lord will have the sins accumulated over countless births destroyed. Those who worship the Lord with fragrant yellow and red lotuses will find a place in the divine abode.

After worshipping the Lord in this manner at night, one should bathe in a river of pure water in the morning.

After bathing, return home, sing praises of the Lord and continue to worship Him. Finally, feed the Brahmins and bid them farewell respectfully and joyfully, providing them with Dakshina.

Afterwards, one should worship the Guru and fulfill one's obligations by giving Dakshina to the Brahmins. Those who take a bath at night should donate curd and honey. Those who desire fruits should offer fruits as donations. Instead of donating oil, one should donate ghee and instead of ghee, milk should be donated. Among grains, rice is the preferred donation.

Those who sleep on the ground during this fast should donate a bed with all the other items. Those who observe silence should donate sesame seeds with gold. Those who do not wear Khadau in the month of Kartika should donate Kharau. Those who abstain from salt during this month should donate sugar. Those who light lamps daily in temples should donate a gold or copper lamp with ghee and wicks.

Those who give up any object during the Chaturmasya fast should resume consuming that object from that day.

Those who observe the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast properly, receive infinite happiness and ultimately attain heaven.

Those who complete the Chaturmasya fast without any interruptions will not have to be reborn. If someone's fast is broken, they should begin it again. Those who listen to or read the Mahatmya (glorification) of this Ekadashi will receive the rewards equivalent to performing the Ashvamedha Yagya."

From the perspective of Vedic study, penance and renunciation, the rules of Chaturmasya are highly significant. This period is especially auspicious for immersing oneself in the devotion to Lord Shri Hari. Householders can also fully benefit from the devotion to Lord Vishnu during Chaturmasya.

Prabodhini Ekadashi is one of the twenty four Ekadashi Vrats which are observed to receive special grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu. According to Hindu beliefs, on this day Lord Vishnu wakes up from four months of Yogic sleep. It is also known as the Dev Uthani Ekadashi and Devutthaan Ekadashi.

Aarti is one of the most important rituals of worshipping any deity. Ekadashi Aarti is a prayer dedicated to Goddess Ekadashi. This Aarti can be sung during Ekadashi fasting and on various occasions related to Ekadashi.

Here we have listed Ekadashi Timings and all the important FAQs related to the Ekadashi fasting so that devotees can avoid the most common mistakes made while observing Ekadashi Vrat.

Goddess Ekadashi is considered as the Yoga Maya of Lord Vishnu. Utpanna Ekadashi is the greatest Ekadashi of all. On this day, Goddess Ekadashi was manifested to kill demon named Mura.

It is believed that Vaikuntha Dwaram is opened on this day and devotees who observe fast on Vaikuntha Ekadashi attain salvation. This is a popular Ekadashi in Tamil calendar. Vaikuntha Ekadashi is also known as Mukkoti Ekadashi.

Nirjala Ekadashi is one of the twenty four Ekadashi Vrats which are observed to receive the special grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu. Consumption of water is prohibited during this fast. By observing the fast of Nirjala Ekadashi, one gets the virtuous results of all the 24 Ekadashis.

Prabodhini Ekadashi is one of the twenty four Ekadashi Vrats which are observed to receive special grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu. According to Hindu beliefs, on this day Lord Vishnu wakes up from four months of Yogic sleep. It is also known as the Dev Uthani Ekadashi and Devutthaan Ekadashi.

According to the Purnimanta Hindu calendar, Margashirsha Krishna Paksha Ekadashi and according to the Amanta Hindu calendar, Kartika Krishna Paksha Ekadashi is known as Utpanna Ekadashi. Ekadashi fasting is started from Utpanna Ekadashi.

Nirjala Ekadashi is one of the twenty four Ekadashi Vrats which are observed to receive the special grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu. Consumption of water is prohibited during this fast. By observing the fast of Nirjala Ekadashi, one gets the virtuous results of all the 24 Ekadashis.

Prabodhini Ekadashi is one of the twenty four Ekadashi Vrats which are observed to receive special grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu. According to Hindu beliefs, on this day Lord Vishnu wakes up from four months of Yogic sleep. It is also known as the Dev Uthani Ekadashi and Devutthaan Ekadashi.

According to the Purnimanta Hindu calendar, Margashirsha Krishna Paksha Ekadashi and according to the Amanta Hindu calendar, Kartika Krishna Paksha Ekadashi is known as Utpanna Ekadashi. Ekadashi fasting is started from Utpanna Ekadashi.

📖 प्रबोधिनी एकादशी व्रत कथा (Vrat Katha Prabodhini Ekadashi)

देवर्षि नारद और ब्रह्मा जी का पावन संवाद

॥ प्रबोधिनी एकादशी अमृत कथा ॥

देवर्षि नारद ने पितामह ब्रह्मा जी से विनीत भाव से पूछा— "हे पितामह! कृपया मुझे कार्तिक मास के शुक्ल पक्ष की प्रबोधिनी एकादशी के व्रत का माहात्म्य सुनाइए।" ब्रह्मा जी ने कहा— "हे मुनिश्रेष्ठ नारद! प्रबोधिनी एकादशी समस्त पापों को हरने वाली, ज्ञान और मुक्ति देने वाली तथा अक्षय पुण्य प्रदान करने वाली है।"

Legends of Prabodhini Ekadashi (पावन पौराणिक सनातन कथा)

Lord Krishna said - "O Arjuna! You are my very dear friend. O Partha! Now, I will tell you the story of Prabodhini Ekadashi, which eliminates sins and bestows merit and liberation. Listen with faith -

In this context, I will share the conversation that took place between Devarshi Narada and Lord Brahma. Once, Narada Ji asked Brahma Ji - "O father! What is the benefit of observing the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast? Please explain the procedure in detail."

Brahma Ji said - "O son! The reward for observing the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast during the Shukla Paksha of the Kartika month is equivalent to the merit gained from performing a thousand Ashvamedha Yajnas and a hundred Rajasuya Yajnas."

Narada Ji replied - "O father! What are the benefits of eating one meal in the evening, eating at night and fasting throughout the day? Please explain in detail."

Brahma Ji said - "O Narada! Eating one meal in the evening can erase the sins of two lifetimes while fasting throughout the day can eliminate the sins of seven lifetimes. That which is difficult to attain in the three worlds can be easily acquired by observing the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast. This fast has the power to instantly destroy even the greatest of sins. By observing the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast, many sinful deeds from past lives can be obliterated in a moment.

Those who observe the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast according to their nature and follow the proper procedures will reap the full benefit.

O son! The merit gained by those who perform even a few virtuous deeds on this day with faith becomes as steadfast as a mountain.

Those who sincerely contemplate within their hearts the desire to observe the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast will have the sins accumulated from a hundred lifetimes erased.

Those who perform a night vigil on Prabodhini Ekadashi will ensure that their past and future ten generations reside in Vishnu Loka. Furthermore, their ancestors, who have suffered many hardships in hell, will also attain Vishnu Loka and experience happiness.

O Narada! Even the gravest sins, such as Brahmahatya, are absolved by observing a night vigil on the occasion of Prabodhini Ekadashi. The rewards of maintaining this vigil on Prabodhini Ekadashi are greater than the benefits derived from sacrifices like the Ashvamedha.

The fruits of undertaking all pilgrimages and donating cows, gold, land and other offerings are equivalent to the rewards gained from observing the night vigil on Prabodhini.

My son, in this world, the life of a person is truly successful if they purify their lineage by observing the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast. All the pilgrimages in the world and all those pilgrimages that can be hoped for reside in the home of the one who observes the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast.

A person should indeed observe the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast in the month of Kartika, setting aside all other activities to gratify Lord Shri Hari. Those who keep this Ekadashi fast will become wealthy, attain the status of a yogi, live as an ascetic and gain mastery over their senses. This observance is highly regarded by Narada and Lord Vishnu. As a result of this fast, a person can free themselves from the cycle of birth and death.

Through the observance of this Ekadashi fast, the sins of all three kinds - physical, verbal and mental are alleviated. Those who engage in charity, penance, oblations, sacrifices and other virtuous acts on this Ekadashi for the attainment of Lord Vishnu will receive boundless blessings.

On the day of Prabodhini Ekadashi, worshipping Lord Shri Hari leads to the destruction of all sins, both from youth and old age. The reward for observing a vigil on the night of this Ekadashi is a thousand times greater than the reward for bathing during a Surya Grahana. The merits a person earns throughout their life are insignificant compared to the merits gained from fasting on Prabodhini Ekadashi. Furthermore, all the merits of those who do not observe the fast on this day are rendered worthless.

Therefore, O son! You should also worship Lord Vishnu using the proper procedure. Those who are righteous and do not eat the food of others, receive the fruit of the Chandrayana fast in the month of Kartika.

In the month of Kartika, the Lord is not as pleased with charity, etc., as He is with listening to the stories of the scriptures.

In the month of Kartika, those who read or listen to even a little of the Lord's story receive the fruit of donating a hundred cows."

Hearing Brahma Ji's words, Narada Ji said - "O father! Now tell me the procedure of the Ekadashi fast and what merit is obtained by observing which kind of fast? Please explain this too."

On hearing Narada's words, Brahma Ji said - "O son! On this Ekadashi, a person should wake up during the Brahma Muhurat. After taking a bath and completing other rituals, one should resolve to fast. At that time, one should pray to Lord Vishnu, saying O Lord! Today I will refrain from food and will eat on the second day. Therefore, please protect me.

After this prayer, one should worship the Lord and begin the fast. The night should be spent near the Lord, engaging in singing, dancing, playing music and reciting stories and Kirtana.

On Prabodhini Ekadashi, one should set aside any stinginess and worship the Lord with many flowers, agarwood, incense and other offerings.

One should offer Arghya to the Lord with water from a conch shell. Its fruit is a crore times more than the donation of pilgrimages, etc.

Those who worship the Lord with Agastya flowers, even Indra folds his hands before them.

Those who worship the Lord with Bilva leaves in the month of Kartika attain liberation in the end.

Those who worship the Lord with Tulasi Ji in the month of Kartika have all the sins of ten thousand births destroyed.

Those who see, touch, meditate on, chant, plant or serve Shri Tulasi Ji in this month reside in the abode of Lord Vishnu for thousands of crores of Yugas.

Those who plant a Tulasi plant, those who are born in their lineage, reside in Vishnu Loka till the end of Pralaya, i.e., cosmic dissolution.

Those who worship the Lord with Kadamba flowers do not suffer the torments of Yamaraja. Lord Vishnu, who fulfills all desires, is very pleased to receive Kadamba flowers. There is nothing greater than worshipping Him with these flowers. Those who offer rose flowers to the Lord certainly attain liberation. Worshipping with Bakula and Ashoka flowers protects one from sorrow for an infinite time. When devotees worship Lord Vishnu with white and red Kanera flowers, the Lord is very pleased with them. If one worships Lord Shri Hari with Durva grass, they receive a hundred times more benefits than from regular worship. Those who offer Shami leaves find it easy to cross the dangerous path of Yamaraja. Lastly, those who worship Lord Vishnu with Champaka flowers are freed from the cycle of life and death.

Those who offer golden Ketaki flowers to the Lord will have the sins accumulated over countless births destroyed. Those who worship the Lord with fragrant yellow and red lotuses will find a place in the divine abode.

After worshipping the Lord in this manner at night, one should bathe in a river of pure water in the morning.

After bathing, return home, sing praises of the Lord and continue to worship Him. Finally, feed the Brahmins and bid them farewell respectfully and joyfully, providing them with Dakshina.

Afterwards, one should worship the Guru and fulfill one's obligations by giving Dakshina to the Brahmins. Those who take a bath at night should donate curd and honey. Those who desire fruits should offer fruits as donations. Instead of donating oil, one should donate ghee and instead of ghee, milk should be donated. Among grains, rice is the preferred donation.

Those who sleep on the ground during this fast should donate a bed with all the other items. Those who observe silence should donate sesame seeds with gold. Those who do not wear Khadau in the month of Kartika should donate Kharau. Those who abstain from salt during this month should donate sugar. Those who light lamps daily in temples should donate a gold or copper lamp with ghee and wicks.

Those who give up any object during the Chaturmasya fast should resume consuming that object from that day.

Those who observe the Prabodhini Ekadashi fast properly, receive infinite happiness and ultimately attain heaven.

Those who complete the Chaturmasya fast without any interruptions will not have to be reborn. If someone's fast is broken, they should begin it again. Those who listen to or read the Mahatmya (glorification) of this Ekadashi will receive the rewards equivalent to performing the Ashvamedha Yagya."

From the perspective of Vedic study, penance and renunciation, the rules of Chaturmasya are highly significant. This period is especially auspicious for immersing oneself in the devotion to Lord Shri Hari. Householders can also fully benefit from the devotion to Lord Vishnu during Chaturmasya.

🌺 गुरुवायुर एकादशी माहात्म्य (Guruvayur Ekadashi Mahatmyam)

केरल स्थित दक्षिण भारत के सुप्रसिद्ध गुरुवायुर श्रीकृष्ण मन्दिर (Guruvayurappan Temple) में वृश्चिक मास (शुक्ल पक्ष) की एकादशी को गुरुवायुर एकादशी के रूप में अत्यंत भव्यता व भक्तिभाव से मनाया जाता है। इसे केरल में 'दक्षिण की वैकुण्ठ एकादशी' भी कहा जाता है।

मान्यता है कि इसी पावन तिथि पर भगवान श्रीकृष्ण ने कुरुक्षेत्र के युद्धक्षेत्र में अर्जुन को श्रीमद्भगवद्गीता का अमर उपदेश दिया था, अतः इसे गीता जयंती के रूप में भी मनाया जाता है। मंदिर में सहस्रों दीप जलाए जाते हैं (एकादशी विळक्कु) और भगवान गुरुवायुरप्पन की स्वर्ण पालकी पर शोभायात्रा निकाली जाती है।

इस दिन गुरुवायुर मंदिर के प्रसिद्ध गजराज 'गुरुवायुर केशवन' (Guruvayur Keshavan) की पुण्यतिथि भी मनाई जाती है, जिन्होंने एकादशी के पावन दिन भगवान के श्रीचरणों में उपवास रखते हुए अपने प्राण त्यागे थे।

🥗 Fasting Food Guide (फलाहार नियम)

गुरुवायुर एकादशी पर अन्न, चावल, दालों का पूर्ण त्याग रहता है। भक्तगण दूध, फल, नारियल जल, साबूदाना आदि फलाहार ग्रहण करते हैं।

🌺 2026 उत्पन्ना एकादशी माहात्म्य (एकादशी देवी का प्राकट्य)

मार्गशीर्ष (अगहन) मास के कृष्ण पक्ष की एकादशी को उत्पन्ना एकादशी (Utpanna Ekadashi) कहा जाता है। इसी पावन तिथि को भगवान श्रीहरि विष्णु के शरीर से एकादशी देवी का प्राकट्य (उत्पत्ति) हुआ था। जो भक्त पहली बार वर्षभर के एकादशी व्रतों का संकल्प लेना चाहते हैं, उन्हें इसी उत्पन्ना एकादशी से अपना व्रत आरंभ करना चाहिए।

📖 उत्पन्ना एकादशी व्रत कथा (Vrat Katha Utpanna Ekadashi)

मुर दैत्य का वध एवं एकादशी देवी का दिव्य प्राकट्य

॥ मार्गशीर्ष कृष्ण उत्पन्ना एकादशी अमर प्रसंग ॥

सतयुग में 'मुर' नाम का एक अत्यंत बलशाली और भयंकर दैत्य था। उसने अपने पराक्रम से इंद्र, वरुण, यम, अग्नि आदि सभी देवताओं को पराजित कर स्वर्ग से निष्कासित कर दिया। भयभीत होकर सभी देवता देवाधिदेव महादेव के पास गए। भगवान शिव ने उन्हें श्रीहरि विष्णु की शरण में जाने को कहा।

देवताओं की करुण पुकार सुनकर भगवान विष्णु ने मुर दैत्य और उसकी सेना से दस हजार वर्षों तक घोर युद्ध किया। अंत में भगवान बसनातनाश्रम स्थित 'हेमावती' गुफा में जाकर विश्राम करने लगे। मुर दैत्य भगवान का वध करने की नीयत से गुफा में प्रवेश कर गया। जैसे ही उसने सोए हुए भगवान पर प्रहार करना चाहा, उसी क्षण भगवान के शरीर से एक अत्यंत तेजस्विनी, दिव्य अस्त्र-शस्त्रों से सुसज्जित देवी प्रकट हुईं।

उस दिव्य देवी ने हुंकार भरते हुए मुर दैत्य के साथ भीषण संग्राम किया और एक ही झटके में उसके अस्त्र-शस्त्र काट दिए और उसका सिर धड़ से अलग कर वध कर दिया। जब भगवान विष्णु निद्रा से जागे, तो उन्होंने मुर दैत्य को मृत देखकर पूछा— "हे देवी! तुम कौन हो और तुमने इस दुर्जेय असुर का वध कैसे किया?" देवी ने कहा— "हे प्रभु! मैं आपकी ही योगशक्ति से आपके शरीर से उत्पन्न हुई हूँ और मैंने इस दुष्ट दैत्य का संहार किया है।"

भगवान श्रीहरि अत्यंत प्रसन्न हुए और कहा— "हे देवी! तुम मार्गशीर्ष कृष्ण एकादशी को मेरे शरीर से उत्पन्न हुई हो, इसलिए तुम्हारा नाम एकादशी होगा। जो मनुष्य तुम्हारा व्रत रखेगा, उसके जन्म-जन्मांतर के पाप नष्ट हो जाएंगे और वह अंत में मेरे परम धाम वैकुण्ठ को प्राप्त करेगा।"

Legends of Utpanna Ekadashi (पावन पौराणिक सनातन कथा)

Shri Sutji said, "O Vipron! Lord Shri Krishna had told this Ekadashi Mahatmya to Arjuna along with the method. Only those who have faith in the Lord listen to this fast with love and after enjoying many pleasures in this world, finally attain Vaikuntha. Once Arjun asked Lord Krishna - "O Janardana! What is the glory of Ekadashi fast? What virtue is gained by observing this fast? What is its method? So please tell me."

Hearing these words of Arjuna, Lord Shri Krishna said, "O Arjuna! First of all, one should fast on Ekadashi of Krishna Paksha of Margashirsha month of Hemant Ritu. One should do Datuna on the evening of Dashami and should not take food at night. On Ekadashi, resolve in the morning. One should work according to the rules. One should take bath in the afternoon with determination. Before bathing, mud paste should be applied on the body. After bathing, sandalwood tilak should be applied on the forehead. The Mantra for applying sandalwood is as follows-

अश्वक्रान्ते रथक्रान्ते विष्णुक्रान्ते वसुन्धरे, उद्धृतापि वराहेण कृष्णेन शतबाहुना। मृत्तिके हर मे पापं यन्मया पूर्वक सञ्चितम्, त्वचा हतेन पापेन गच्छामि परमां गतिम्॥

Ashvakrante Rathakrante Vishnukrante Vasundhare, Uddhritapi Varahena Krishnena Shatabahuna। Mrittike Hara Me Papam Yanmaya Purvaka Sanchitam, Tvacha Hatena Papena Gachchhami Paramam Gatim॥

After taking bath, one should worship God with Dhoopa (incense), Deepa and Naivedya. Deepdan should be done at night. All these virtuous deeds should be done with devotion. One should chant the name of Shri Hari while keeping vigil at night and should stay away from any kind of pleasures or women's affairs. Only pure and virtuous thoughts should be given place in the heart. On this day, donations should be given to Brahmins with devotion, and one should seek forgiveness from them for their sins. Religious people should consider both Ekadashis of Shukla Paksha and Krishna Paksha as equal. There should not be any discrimination between them. According to the above method, the virtue that people who observe Ekadashi fast, get by visiting Shankhodhara Teertha and Darshan, is not even equal to one sixteenth part of the virtue of Ekadashi fast. Hey Arjuna! The same virtue that a person gets by donating in Vyatipata Yoga, Sankranti, during solar eclipse and lunar eclipse and by taking bath in Kurukshetra, a person gets the same virtue by fasting on Ekadashi. O son of Kunti! The result that one gets by donating a thousand cows to Vedapathi Brahmins is ten times more than that by fasting on Punya Ekadashi. The virtue gained by feeding ten great Brahmins is equal to one-tenth of the virtue of Ekadashi. Half the benefit of observing Nirjala Vrat is equivalent to eating one meal at a time. Therefore, only by fasting on Ekadashi, one can attain Yagya, charity, penance, etc. Otherwise, one must observe the fast on Ekadashi. One should not drink water from the conch during this Ekadashi fast. Non-vegetarian and other vegetarian food is completely prohibited during the fast of Ekadashi. The results of Ekadashi fast are greater than a thousand Yajnas."

Hearing the words of Lord Shri Krishna, Arjun said, "O Lord! Why have you described the virtues of this Ekadashi fast as better and more sacred than the virtues of many pilgrimages? Please tell all this in detail."

Shri Krishna said, "O Partha! There was a very dangerous demon in Satyayuga, his name was Mura. That demon defeated the Indra and other gods and removed them from their positions. After that Indra prayed to Lord Shankar, "O Bholenath! All of us gods are living our lives in the mortal world, saddened by the atrocities of the demon Mura. We are suffering a lot due to the fear of demons. I myself am very sad and scared, what to talk about other gods, so O Kailashpati! Please tell me the solution to protect myself from the atrocities of the demon Mura.

Hearing the prayer of Devraj, Shankarji said, "O Devendra! You go to Lord Shri Hari. Lord Vishnu, who killed Madhu-Kaitabha, will definitely free the gods from this fear."

As per the orders of Mahadevji, Indra and other gods went to Ksheer Sagar, where Lord Shri Hari was seated on the Shesha shaiya.

All the gods including Indra appeared before Lord Vishnu and praised him, "O Lord of the three worlds! You are worthy of praise; we all the gods offer our obeisances to you. O destroyer of demons! We take refuge in you, please protect us. O Trilokapati! We all the gods have come to your refuge in fear of the atrocities of the demons. At this time the demons have driven us out of heaven and we all the gods are wandering in the Mrityuloka in a very pitiful condition. Now you are our protector! Protect us! O Kailashapati! O Jagannath! Protect us."

Hearing the pitiful cry of the gods, Lord Shri Hari said, "O gods! Which demon is that who has conquered the gods? For whose fear are you all the gods wandering in the earth? Is that demon so strong that he along with Indra has Have you conquered all the gods? You fearlessly tell me the whole story."

Hearing these affectionate words of Lord Vishnu, Devendra said, "O Lord! In ancient times, there was a demon named Nadi Jangam, born in the Brahmavansha, who had a son named Mura, who resided in a city named Chandravati, who by his strength He has conquered the Mrityuloka and the Devaloka and has expelled all the gods from the Devaloka and has made the demons of his demon clan the guardians of the world like Indra, Agni, Yama, Varuna, Chandra etc. He himself becomes the Sun and heats the earth and becomes clouds to rains water, hence you protect the gods by killing this powerful and terrible demon."

Hearing such words from Devendra's mouth, Lord Vishnu said, "O Gods! I will soon kill your enemy. All of you come with me to Chandravati city right now."

On the call of the gods, Lord Vishnu immediately went with them. On the other hand, the demon king Mura had come to know from his power that Shri Vishnu was coming towards his capital with the desire of war, hence he along with his demon warriors also came to the battlefield and started roaring. Within no time the war started. When the war started, countless demons started fighting with the gods wearing various weapons, but the gods were already scared, they could not face the demons for long and ran away. Then Lord Vishnu himself came to the battlefield. The demons became more enthusiastic than before and started fighting with Lord Vishnu. They started attacking them fiercely with their weapons. Shri Vishnu started destroying the attacks of demons with the blows of his Chakra and Gada (Mace). In this war, many demons died forever, but the demon king Mura continued fighting with Lord Vishnu without any fear. It seemed as if his hair had not even grown yet. He was fighting without fear. Whatever weapons Lord Vishnu used to kill Mura, all of them were destroyed by his radiance and started falling on him like flowers. Even after using many weapons, Lord Vishnu could not win over him. Then they started wrestling amongst themselves. Lord Shri Hari kept fighting with that demon for a thousand years for the gods but could not win. At last, Lord Vishnu, desiring to rest peacefully, entered a cave named Hemavati located at Badarika Ashram, which was thirty-eight Kosa long and had a single door.

O Arjuna! The Lord slept in that cave. That demon had also followed Lord Vishnu. Seeing Lord Sri Hari sleeping, he got ready to kill him. He was thinking, "Today I will kill my eternal enemy and become free from evil forever", but his wish could not be fulfilled, because at the same time a extremely beautiful divine girl wearing divine clothes emerged from the body of Lord Vishnu. She was born and challenged the demon and started fighting with him.

Seeing that girl, the demon was extremely surprised and started wondering where such a divine girl came from. After that, the demon continued fighting with that girl. After some time, the girl got angry and destroyed the demon's weapon - The weapons were cut into pieces. Broke his chariot. Now the demon got very angry and breaking all the rules, he started wrestling with the girl.

That brilliant girl made that demon unconscious with one blow and before he could lose his unconsciousness, he cut off his head and severed it from his body.

As soon as his head was cut off, that demon fell on the earth and died and the remaining demons, seeing such a tragic end for their king, got scared and ran away to the Paatal Loka. When Lord Vishnu woke up from sleep, he was surprised to see that demon dead and he started wondering who had killed this great warrior?

Then that brilliant girl folded her hands and said to Shri Hari, "O Jagdishwara! This demon was ready to kill you, then I, born from your body, have killed this demon."

Listening to the girl, God said, "You have killed this demon, hence O girl! I am very happy with you. By ending this Rakshasa, you have defeated the suffering of the gods of the three worlds, hence you can ask for the boon as per your wish. I will fulfill your every wish."

Listening to God, the girl said, "O Lord! Grant me this boon that whoever fasts for me, all his sins will be destroyed and in the end, he will attain heaven. I will get half the fruit of my fast at night. And the person who eats food at one time gets half of its fruit. Those devotees who observe my fast with devotion will definitely attain Vaikuntha Loka. The person who eats food once during the day and night during my fast, may he be full of wealth and grains. Please grant me such a boon."

Lord Shri Hari said, "O girl! It will be like this. My devotees and you will be one and will ultimately attain fame in the world and attain my world. O Kalyani! You have appeared on Ekadashi, that is why your name is also Ekadashi. It happened. Because you were born from my part, that is why you will be famous in the world by the name of Utpanna Ekadashi and all the sins of the people who fast on this day will be completely destroyed. You will now even more dear to me than Teeja, Ashtami, Navami and Chaudasa. The result of your fast will be greater than the results of all pilgrimages. This is my irrefutable statement."

Having said this, Lord Sri Hari disappeared at that very place."

Shri Krishna said, "O son of Pandu! The result of fasting on Ekadashi is greater than all the fasts and the results of all the pilgrimages. I destroy the enemies of the people who observe Ekadashi fast and grant salvation to the person observing the fast. Whatever troubles those people face in life, I destroy them also. That is, the person who observes the fast of Ekadashi, which is very dear to me, becomes fearless and happy from all sides and finally attains salvation. O son of Kunti! This I have told you about the origin of Ekadashi. Ekadashi fast destroys all sins and grants success. Great people should consider the Ekadashis of both the Paksha to be equal. It is not right to discriminate between them. The person who will listen and read the Ekadashi Mahatmya, will get the same results as the Ashwamedha Yagya. This is my irrefutable word."

Ekadashi is the visible power of Lord Vishnu, the power which has killed the demon named Mura, whom even God was unable to defeat, how can the demon in the form of human sins stand in front of that power? The power which removed the sufferings of the gods and gave them happiness can provide anything to mere mortals. Therefore, by the grace of Goddess Ekadashi, all types of happiness, prosperity, peace and salvation are easily attained.

According to the Purnimanta Hindu calendar, Margashirsha Krishna Paksha Ekadashi and according to the Amanta Hindu calendar, Kartika Krishna Paksha Ekadashi is known as Utpanna Ekadashi. Ekadashi fasting is started from Utpanna Ekadashi.

Aarti is one of the most important rituals of worshipping any deity. Ekadashi Aarti is a prayer dedicated to Goddess Ekadashi. This Aarti can be sung during Ekadashi fasting and on various occasions related to Ekadashi.

Here we have listed Ekadashi Timings and all the important FAQs related to the Ekadashi fasting so that devotees can avoid the most common mistakes made while observing Ekadashi Vrat.

A complete list of Ekadashi dates is given here. Go through the Ekadashi fasting dates list here so that you never miss fasting on Ekadashi. Ekadashi fast is observed with great enthusiasm by the devotees of Lord Vishnu.

Goddess Ekadashi is considered as the Yoga Maya of Lord Vishnu. Utpanna Ekadashi is the greatest Ekadashi of all. On this day, Goddess Ekadashi was manifested to kill demon named Mura.

It is believed that Vaikuntha Dwaram is opened on this day and devotees who observe fast on Vaikuntha Ekadashi attain salvation. This is a popular Ekadashi in Tamil calendar. Vaikuntha Ekadashi is also known as Mukkoti Ekadashi.

Nirjala Ekadashi is one of the twenty four Ekadashi Vrats which are observed to receive the special grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu. Consumption of water is prohibited during this fast. By observing the fast of Nirjala Ekadashi, one gets the virtuous results of all the 24 Ekadashis.

Prabodhini Ekadashi is one of the twenty four Ekadashi Vrats which are observed to receive special grace and blessings of Lord Vishnu. According to Hindu beliefs, on this day Lord Vishnu wakes up from four months of Yogic sleep. It is also known as the Dev Uthani Ekadashi and Devutthaan Ekadashi.

According to the Purnimanta Hindu calendar, Margashirsha Krishna Paksha Ekadashi and according to the Amanta Hindu calendar, Kartika Krishna Paksha Ekadashi is known as Utpanna Ekadashi. Ekadashi fasting is started from Utpanna Ekadashi.
